name: Everpop API
description: Turn your own videos into published Shorts for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, with measured receipts on eligible YouTube Shorts. Built to be driven by AI agents: upload a file, clip it, publish it, and pull real 48h/7d performance — all by API. REST and MCP need the Pro or Scale plan; other accounts get HTTP 402 with reason subscription (no active subscription) or plan (the plan doesn't include API access). Full agent guide: https://everpop.app/skill.md · MCP connector: https://everpop.app/api/mcp/mcp (OAuth, or Authorization: Bearer epk_...)
